owner: CEO / Master Agent + COO-1 Execution Architect
purpose: Scale the product factory into 10 production functions with 10 worker-agents per function so products move from idea to deployed offer, revenue test and stop/continue decision without waiting.
operating_rule: More agents are only useful when routed through a single proof-based production line. Every worker must ship an artifact, metric, decision, or blocker update. No worker may stay idle: if blocked, switch to the fallback task and escalate the blocker.
p0_product_focus: Parts Seller OS remains the protected primary build. New opportunities go through the Opportunity Lab and cannot consume P0 capacity until gate-approved.
global_daily_outputs: one shippable product artifact or one validated revenue action per active function
one written blocker/fallback update for every blocked lane
one proof path per done claim
one CFO continue/stop signal for every active product test

functions.name: Product Factory Boilerplate Crew
functions.mission: Maintain a reusable product skeleton so every new product starts with landing, pricing, payment, dashboard, analytics, legal pages and deploy config instead of starting from zero.
functions.primary_kpi: new MVP shell can be created in one repeatable run with URL/payment/analytics placeholders
functions.input: approved product idea or P0 feature request

functions.name: Idea To MVP In One Day Crew
functions.mission: Force every promising idea through a same-day product brief, buyer definition, offer, demo, price, payment path and outreach plan.
functions.primary_kpi: idea has URL, offer, demo path, price and first outreach list before it can remain active
functions.input: raw opportunity, competitor insight or user request
functions.output: one-day MVP brief and launch checklist

functions.name: Build Orchestrator Crew
functions.mission: Break build work into small tasks, assign owners, remove blockers and keep the product moving until a proof artifact exists.
functions.primary_kpi: no active product task remains without next_action, owner, blocker/fallback and output_path
functions.input: MVP brief, product gate, bug or user request
functions.output: routed build tickets and shipped proof

functions.name: Reusable Component Library Crew
functions.mission: Maintain reusable UI/copy components so pages are assembled like Lego: hero, pricing, forms, dashboards, listings, trust blocks and email templates.
functions.primary_kpi: new landing/product page can be assembled from approved components without custom design from zero
functions.input: product shell, product brief or conversion critic request

functions.name: Deploy Robot Crew
functions.mission: Convert local product work into public, testable, rollback-safe deployments with preview URLs and health checks.
functions.primary_kpi: every done product claim has public URL or explicit NO URL blocker
functions.input: repo product folder or pull request
functions.output: preview URL, smoke test result and rollback note

functions.name: QA And Conversion Critic Crew
functions.mission: Break-test both technical function and money logic before anything is called done.
functions.primary_kpi: each release has technical QA score, conversion QA score and fixed/accepted issue list
functions.input: preview URL, product shell, landing page or workflow demo
functions.output: QA verdict with fix queue and conversion verdict

functions.name: Revenue Ops Autopilot Crew
functions.mission: Make every MVP sellable by producing exact lead lists, outreach messages, follow-ups, CRM states, quote/payment flow and daily sales status.
functions.primary_kpi: every MVP gets at least 50 targeted leads or a documented blocker/fallback segment
functions.input: launched MVP, target buyer, offer and pricing
functions.output: lead pipeline, outreach sequence and paid-pilot path

functions.name: Competitor Intelligence To Asset Factory Crew
functions.mission: Turn competitor posts, pages, ads and offers into reusable hooks, pages, scripts, pricing ideas, objections and SEO assets.
functions.primary_kpi: weekly competitor input becomes publishable copy/assets, not just notes
functions.input: competitor examples, screenshots, public pages, ads or market patterns
functions.output: hooks, landing copy, post drafts, video scripts and offer tests

functions.name: CFO Gate Crew
functions.mission: Stop unprofitable work early by checking cost, price, margin, customer acquisition effort and continue/stop thresholds.
functions.primary_kpi: no product remains active without unit economics and a continue/stop rule
functions.input: product brief, revenue data, tool cost, delivery scope
functions.output: CFO score, price recommendation and continue/stop decision

functions.name: Product Stop/Pivot Crew
functions.mission: Prevent stagnation by stopping, pivoting, parking or promoting product tests based on evidence within a fixed validation window.
functions.primary_kpi: every active product has a dated next verdict: continue, pivot, park or stop
functions.input: MVP results, outreach results, QA results and CFO score
